cases.label: baseline-dt-t2-h1-varlen
cases.state_definition: Each hardware token begins clear per AIC, source CUBE, destination MTE1, and event ID. On WAIT consume; on SET record excess if already live then set. Prefix certificates require two SETs of the same ID before the trace has issued any matching WAIT. Later boolean replay can differ from CA callback counts under overlapping/excluded waits; the callback count remains authoritative. Use only actual per-core X instructions sorted by issue timestamp and shard order at equal tick. Compare to independent simulator callback log, normalized by the captured ELF base.
